dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Hey, there you are! This sure is a mysterious place...

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: I've taken a ton of photos — and boy, do I have a list of questions for you!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: It's idyllic. And the lighting is perfect — you can take the most beautiful photos from literally any angle.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: And yet... We're currently inside your teapot... right?

choices.text: That's right. Does that worry you?

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: No, not really. I was just wondering... What happens if someone opens the lid and pours water in?

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: How would that manifest in here? A flood? A storm? Would the water level start rising from beneath our feet?

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: I'd love to record that as it happens... Would you mind heading outside for a second and pouring some water in?

choices.text: I don't use this pot to brew tea. So don't worry.

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Really? You've never brewed tea in here? Ah, well that's a shame. I was going to ask you about how this unique environment affects the flavor of the tea.

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: I heard this legend during an interview with someone from Liyue once. They said there was once an adeptus who poured half of the Bishui River into their teapot to brew some tea...

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: When the tea was ready, the adeptus poured the whole pot back into the river, and that's how the river got its distinct color.

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: No idea if there's any truth to it... I'd sure like to taste the water from the Bishui River if I ever got the chance, just to see if there's any hint of a tea flavor.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Sure — anything you wanna know about in particular? Ooh, I know... I'll tell you about the time that "Bedazzled!" caused a huge scandal.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: They once ran a special report which claimed that the production and promotion of Fonta was part of a sinister plot by the Fontaine Research Institute.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sounds like a tasty conspiracy theory.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Right? Anyway, they put forward a theory that long-term consumption of Fonta makes human teeth and bones incredibly fragile.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: It would end up destroying people's bodies to the point where they could no longer take care of themselves — even walking and eating would be agonizingly difficult.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Finally, people would be forced into relying on machines just to survive. And that's when the Fontaine Research Institute, who develops all kinds of meka, would swoop in to save the day and turn a huge profit in the process.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That's extremely far-fetched...

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Most of my colleagues and I thought so, too. As far as we're concerned, "Bedazzled!" makes up things like this all the time, so we thought nothing of it.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: But it turned out that a whole bunch of people who already hated Fonta were completely convinced it was true... Well, either that, or they saw it as a good opportunity to vent their grievances.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Either way, after that article was published, the Maison Gestion was inundated with complaint letters accusing Fonta of harming children.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: They claimed that Fonta doesn't just damage childrens' teeth, but also stunts their growth, discourages them from drinking plain water, and ruins their appetites...

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: It all got so out of hand that Mr. Heinry got pressured into doing a public interview with The Steambird, in which he stated that he would personally prove that Fonta was harmless...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How did he plan to do that?

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: He declared that he would start drinking three cups of Fonta every day until he turned 60.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: He also promised to publish the results of his monthly physical check-ups in The Steambird to make them available for public scrutiny.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I shouldn't laugh, but... This is a hilarious story.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Hahaha, it really is. We've been joking about it in the office ever since. He's never gonna live this one down.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: To his credit though, Mr. Heinry managed to turn the whole fiasco into a huge publicity stunt for Fonta. Their sales really rocketed for a while off the back of this.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: And for all his big promises about publishing his monthly medical reports and drinking Fonta till he turned 60... Well, a few months later, everyone had moved on and forgotten all about it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Anything you'd like to do?

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Well... I'd like to take some photos for work, if it's alright with you?

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: I'd love to do a story about that big plump talking finch, for example. Now that would be an interesting read!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You'd have to ask Tubby for her permission on that...

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Ahh, so Tubby's its name... Don't worry, I'm a professional! I always make sure to get people's consent before publishing anything that's specifically about them.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Speaking of consent, would you have any objections to the general public learning about this wondrous teapot of yours?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Please keep my poor teapot out of the talons of The Steambird, Charlotte...

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Sure thing. If you're not comfortable with me reporting on it, I'll keep it out of the news.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: But... Could you at least tell me... who made this teapot for you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It was an adeptus from Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: An adeptus? Wow! Uh... Maybe you could introduce me? I'm so fascinated by the adepti — I'd love to learn more about them.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: I hear there's all sorts of rules and taboos you have to observe when you're seeking an adeptus... Are you able to go over all of that with me?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's not that complicated. I can just take you there.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Really!? Amazing. Well that settles it — I'll put it in my schedule and come find you when I'm ready. No backing out, okay?

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: ...I knew you were well-connected, but wow, fraternizing with the adepti? That's really incredible.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Now that I've got a friend like you, I'll never need to worry about networking again! Hahaha...

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: An exclusive interview with an adeptus... What would a good title be? ..."Investigating an Adeptus"?

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: No, no, no, it needs to sound more reverent — they'd probably have me thrown down the mountain for suggesting that...

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Journey to Jueyun... Ooh, that's it! I think I'll go with: "Journey to Jueyun: Liyue's Pilgrim Trail."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good morning, Charlotte.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Morning! Oh, snap, look at the time — I'd better go grab today's paper.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: I'll bring a copy back for you as well.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good night, Charlotte.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Good night! Ahh... At this hour, I'd usually be proofreading a manuscript or drafting my next one...

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: I'm not used to having so much free time. Hahaha...

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: *gasp* Wait... Did I submit my latest article? I think I did...? Yeah, pretty sure I did...

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Whoa, this is giving me deja vu... Takes me right back to when I was a rookie journalist, scouring the streets for potential news stories.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Where you get a lot of people gathered in one place, information starts to circulate. It's out of that environment that news is born. So we're not likely to stumble across any big stories today, with only you and me here.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: But that aside — if you're looking to stock up that newsstand, I recommend The Steambird.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Hey, my place in the Court of Fontaine has the same furniture! But somehow, the sight of it has a weird way of making me sleepy...

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Oh, I know what it is... There've been times in the past when I've worked pretty much around the clock trying to make a deadline, and I'd be constantly going back and forth between a bed and a chair that are the spitting image of these.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: If it's okay with you, could I use this place as my secret writing chamber once in a while?
